commons.title: XRF-Hainuwele.jpg
commons.description: Hainuwele defecating valuable objects. Hainuwele is a figure from the Wemale folklore of the island of Seram in the Maluku Islands, Indonesia. Her story is an origin myth.
commons.editorial_reason: The caption ties it to Wemale folklore, but the tile is a digital illustration rather than a photograph of visible Wemale cultural material.
